title: Performance & GPU Tuning
desc: Getting the most throughput from local synthesis.
lede: A few levers make local synthesis faster and steadier.
body:
At a glance
  • GPU/VRAM considerations.
  • CPS auto-tuning and ETA.
  • Large-book load performance.

GPU & VRAM

A CUDA GPU dramatically speeds local synthesis. More VRAM lets heavier engines and longer chunks run comfortably.

Throughput & scale

Studio auto-tunes characters-per-second estimates for accurate ETAs and is built to keep large books responsive. Declare honest engine resource profiles so scheduling avoids collisions.
